;Armed conflicts and attacks
*[[Arif Wazir]], a prominent [[Pashtun Tahafuz Movement|PTM]] leader, dies of injuries from an attack that was carried out in a [[drive-by shooting]] in [[Wanna, Pakistan]], a day earlier. [https://gandhara.rferl.org/a/pashtun-rights-activist-killed-in-waziristan-gun-attack/30588994.html (Radio Free Europe/Radio Liberty)]
*[[Iraqi insurgency (2017–present)]]
**At least 10 members of the [[Popular Mobilization Forces]] are killed by [[Islamic State of Iraq and the Levant|ISIL]] militants in attacks in the town of Mekeeshfa and the city of [[Balad, Iraq|Balad]]. [[Iraq]] and the [[paramilitary]] forces' official media report that scores of others were wounded. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2020/05/isil-attack-kills-hashd-al-shaabi-forces-iraq-reports-200502021705978.html (Al Jazeera)]
*[[Mali War]], [[Operation Barkhane]]
**A [[French Foreign Legion]] soldier dies at a [[military hospital]] in [[Paris]], after being wounded in an [[Improvised explosive device|IED]] blast, while conducting an operation against [[Islamist]] [[insurgent]]s in [[Mali]]. [https://www.thestar.com.my/news/world/2020/05/02/french-foreign-legion-soldier-dies-after-being-wounded-in-mali (''The Star'')]

;Disasters and accidents
*Six people are killed after a [[Beechcraft 95-B55 Baron]] crashes near [[Teniente Jorge Henrich Arauz Airport]], [[Bolivia]]. [https://aviation-safety.net/wikibase/235672 (Aviation Safety Network)]

;International relations
*[[Foreign relations of Palau]]
**[[President of Palau]] [[Thomas Remengesau Jr.]] condemns [[Political status of Taiwan|the exclusion]] of [[Taiwan]] from the [[World Health Organization]], saying that it "endangers, not only [[Taiwanese people]], but people everywhere". Palau remains one of Taiwan's few political allies in the [[Oceania|Pacific]]. [https://www.rnz.co.nz/international/pacific-news/415672/who-s-exclusion-of-taiwan-endangers-covid-19-fight-palau (RNZ)] 
*[[Venezuelan presidential crisis]]
**[[Brazil]]'s [[Supreme Federal Court]] issues a 10-day [[injunction]] against [[President of Brazil|President]] [[Jair Bolsonaro]]'s demand that all 30 members of [[Venezuela]]'s diplomatic team leave the country. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-brazil-venezuela/brazils-top-court-suspends-move-to-expel-venezuelan-diplomats-idUSKBN22E0VG?il=0 (Reuters)]

;Law and crime
*Inmates take seven guards [[hostage]] at a prison in [[Manaus]], Brazil, during an attempted [[prison escape|escape]]. A raid later frees the guards and ends the prisoners' [[rebellion]]. [https://globalnews.ca/news/6898231/brazil-prison-inmates-coronavirus-hostage/ (Global News)]

;Politics and elections
*[[North Korea]]'s state-run [[Korean Central News Agency]] reports that [[List of leaders of North Korea|leader]] [[Kim Jong-un]] attended the ribbon-cutting ceremony for a fertilizer plant today, in his first official appearance since his disappearance from public focus last month. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-north-korea-leader/after-rumours-about-health-north-korea-state-media-report-kim-jong-un-appearance-idUSKBN22D6DD?il=0 (Reuters)]
